description: Aménagements Cyclables - Département du Calvados is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département du Calvados. State of play of the Calvados cycling facilities Collection context The Active Mobility department of the Department of Calvados is responsible for implementing the bike plan defined by the departmental council for 15 years and has established a linear state in order to monitor its evolution. Coverage: Département du Calvados. The portal shows the English title as "Cycling facilities - Department of Calvados" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Département du Calvados. Its keywords include voie-verte, donnee-ouverte, nature, velo, balade, velotourisme. The listing shows 3 download or service links in GPKG, GEOJSON. The listing shows 2026-04-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
